description: Read the full text of a codemate.com article or client case study, given the URL that search_site, list_articles or list_references returned. Returns the title, date, metadata and the page's prose. Use this after a search to actually read a result — search only returns a summary. For Codemate's main service and product pages, use get_topic instead.

url.description: The codemate.com URL (or path) of an article or case study, from a search or list result.

name: get_page_data
